evidence_quotes.agenda: "is there any concern that you'd like to talk about before I discussed with you the pricing as well?" — asked right at the top, before any logistics probing
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Real concern surfaced late in the call — "it was just like a different experience...they were kind of like moving slower...I just don't want that to happen again" — rep gave a substantive resolution, not a brush-off
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we used during the move"

top_strength: When the customer raised a real concern about a slow crew from a past move, the rep diagnosed the likely cause (a trainee mover), flagged her as a repeat customer, and committed to requesting the branch's most experienced team — genuine problem-solving, not a script reflex.
coaching_note: That same crew-quality reassurance is functionally the Meet Your Mover differentiator delivered well, but the On-Time Guarantee and Communication takeaway were never mentioned — worth folding in given how receptive this customer clearly was.
